title: Roy Gist obituary
text:
Roy Gist.

SAVOY, Texas.—Funeral services were held Tuesday afternoon in Paris for Roy Gist, 55, native of Savoy, who was killed early Monday in an automobile accident in Pittsburg. The body was returned to Savoy for burial in Sunnyside cemetery.

Mr. Gist, who owned a feed store in Paris, had gone to Pittsburg for a load of hay and had stopped at a store for a drink when his truck was struck from the rear by an automobile. Having just stepped from the truck he was knocked to the ground by a part of the hay rack and was run over by the automobile. He died instantly.

Son of Mr. and Mrs. G. N. Gist, pioneers of this county, he was born and reared in Savoy. He was married to Miss Ethel Alston of Ector and for the past 12 years the family has resided in Paris.

Survivors are his wife; four children, Oleah Gist of Talco, Mrs. Leslie Counts and G. A. Gist of Tyler and Morrell Gist of the home address; two sisters, Mrs. Sam Martin of Shawnee, Okla., and Mrs. Essie Woodward of Wolfe City; and a brother, E. N. Gist of Bonham.
